title: Tvheadend (LinuxServer.io)
tagline: Works as a proxy server: is a Tv streaming server and recorder for Linux, Freebsd and Android supporting Dvb-S, Dvb-S2, Dvb-C, Dvb-T, Atsc, Isdb-T, Iptv, Sat>Ip and Hdhomerun as input sources. Tvheadend offers the Http (Vlc, Mplayer), Htsp (Kodi, Movian) and Sat>Ip streaming. Multiple Epg sources are supported (over-the-air Dvb and Atsc including Opentv Dvb extensions, Xmltv, Pyxml).
